mapper.insert: INSERT /* LGVPAY00015.insertAggregateDetail */ INTO tb_pay_item_aggr_detail_n( payroll_item_aggregate_id /* 급여항목집계아이디 */ , payroll_item_detail_detail_id /* 급여항목상세내역아이디 */ , effective_start_yyyymmdd /* 유효시작년월일 */ , payroll_item_id /* 급여항목아이디 */ , pay_item_classification_code /* 급여항목분류코드 */ , effective_end_yyyymmdd /* 유효종료년월일 */ , creation_date /* 생성일자 */ , creation_user_id /* 생성사용자아이디 */ ) VALUES ( #{payrollItemAggregateId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* payroll_item_aggregate_id => 급여항목집계아이디 */ , CASE WHEN #{payrollAggregateTypeCode} = 'ITEM' THEN #{payrollItemDetailDetailId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* ITEM인 경우 화면에서 전달된 값으로 입력 */ ELSE /* CLASS 또는 METHOD 인 경우 중복 안되는 마이너스 시퀀스 값 입력 */ NVL(( SELECT MIN(piad.payroll_item_detail_detail_id) /* 마이너스 값이므로 MIN으로 조회 */ FROM tb_pay_item_aggr_detail_n piad WHERE piad.payroll_item_aggregate_id = #{payrollItemAggregateId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ), 0) -1 END /* payroll_item_detail_detail_id => 급여항목상세내역아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{effectiveStartYyyymmdd}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') /* effective_start_yyyymmdd => 유효시작년월일 */ , #{payrollItemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* payroll_item_id => 급여항목아이디 */ , #{payItemClassificationCode} /* pay_item_classification_code => 급여항목분류코드 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{effectiveEndYyyymmdd} , 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') /* effective_end_yyyymmdd => 유효종료년월일 */ , SYSDATE /* creation_date => 생성일자 */ , #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} /* creation_user_id => 생성사용자아이디 */ )
mapper.update: UPDATE /* LGVPAY00015.updateAggregateDetail */ tb_pay_item_aggr_detail_n SET payroll_item_detail_detail_id = #{payrollItemDetailDetailId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 급여항목상세내역아이디 */ , payroll_item_id = #{payrollItemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 급여항목아이디 */ , pay_item_classification_code = #{payItemClassificationCode} /* 급여항목분류코드 */ , effective_start_yyyymmdd = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{effectiveStartYyyymmdd}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') /* 유효시작년월일 */ , effective_end_yyyymmdd = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{effectiveEndYyyymmdd}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') /* 유효종료년월일 */ WHERE payroll_item_aggregate_id = #{payrollItemAggregateId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 급여항목집계아이디 */ AND payroll_item_detail_detail_id = #{oriPayrollItemDetailId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 급여항목상세내역아이디 */ AND effective_start_yyyymmdd = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{oriEffectiveStartYyyymmdd}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') /* 유효시작년월일 */
mapper.delete: DELETE /* LGVPAY00015.deleteAggregateDetail */ FROM tb_pay_item_aggr_detail_n WHERE payroll_item_aggregate_id = #{payrollItemAggregateId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 급여항목집계아이디 */ AND payroll_item_detail_detail_id = #{oriPayrollItemDetailId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 급여항목상세내역아이디 */ AND effective_start_yyyymmdd = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{oriEffectiveStartYyyymmdd}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') /* 유효시작년월일 */
DELETE /* LGVPAY00015.deleteAggregateDetailAll */ FROM tb_pay_item_aggr_detail_n WHERE payroll_item_aggregate_id = #{payrollItemAggregateId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 급여항목집계아이디 */
